caption: The drawing depicts a single, large glass decanter with a stopper. The decanter has a wide, rounded body that narrows sharply into a short neck topped with a decorative stopper. The stopper is dome-shaped with ridged details and sits securely on the decanter’s neck. The neck of the decanter features several horizontal band-like rings and a rounded bulb just below the stopper. The main body of the decanter is decorated with a pattern of vertical, elongated oval and teardrop-shaped cuttings arranged in regular intervals. The overall color scheme of the drawing is in grayscale tones, with shading used to indicate transparency and the reflective qualities of the glass. The image is rendered in pencil or graphite on a light beige paper background, filling most of the space with the decanter, and there are minimal details in the background apart from a faint border line.
title: Carafe
